features.title: Rift Mark one-shot vulnerability
features.gap: Shadow Crypt failure consequences were immediate damage only; no bounded enemy-created pressure survived into the next read.
features.adaptation: A failed Rift Skirmisher read applies one source-tracked mark that adds +6 to the next authoritative failed-defense telegraph, capped by the existing 40-damage threat ceiling, then consumes once.
features.acceptance: initial failure remains 18; ledger exposes +6; next threat advertises true 36 damage in Entry Seal; one failed read consumes the old mark before applying any new role pressure

features.title: Veil Ward ally protection
features.gap: Veil Channeler had interruptible pressure but no support behavior that changes target choice or damage routing.
features.adaptation: A failed interrupt grants one 14-point health-only ward to the deterministic lowest-health-ratio living ally. The ward reports actual absorbed damage and cannot go negative.
features.acceptance: deterministic target; exactly 14 durability; health-only absorption; one-shot depletion; source defeat/purge removes it

features.title: Gravebound guard link
features.gap: Gravebound Bulwark could pressure posture but did not protect another enemy or create a tactical support target.
features.adaptation: A failed brace creates a one-attack link to the highest-priority living ally, reducing exactly 10 posture pressure. Staggering/defeating the Bulwark or consuming the link removes it.
features.acceptance: deterministic ally; exactly 10 posture protected; consumed once; no negative posture; inactive when source is staggered/defeated

features.title: Pressure-aware target recommendation
features.gap: Recommendation prioritized role/stagger/counter state but did not react to an enemy actively sustaining a mark, ward, or guard link.
features.adaptation: A living enemy that sources active pressure receives a bounded +60 tactical recommendation priority while manual player lock remains authoritative.
features.acceptance: support source can outrank ordinary role priority; dead/inactive pressure stops contributing; manual target lock behavior is unchanged

features.title: Skillful pressure purge
features.gap: Adding pressure without an earned removal route would turn mistakes into passive attrition instead of action-combat counterplay.
features.adaptation: Pressure sourced by an enemy is removed by either a precision semantic defense against that source or a role-matched attack that consumes an earned breach.
features.acceptance: ordinary successful defense does not purge; precision defense purges; matching breach exploit purges; timing thresholds and existing breach costs are not weakened

features.title: Read-only combat status ledger
features.gap: The new pressure states need exact source/target/magnitude visibility without taking renderer or HUD ownership.
features.adaptation: Expose a bounded deterministic game-domain ledger for Rift Mark, Veil Ward, and Bulwark Guard Link. It is presentation-agnostic and does not claim a rendered HUD.
features.acceptance: source, target, kind, and magnitude are exact; capacity is bounded; repeated reads do not mutate threat state; invalid timing does not mutate; cancel clears transient entries
